title: HealthTool.tsx's phone cell lookup falls back to getElementById, which can hide a broken activeCellIn in the phone hand-off tests
evidence: widget-src/src/components/HealthTool.tsx:466: activeCellIn(...) ?? document.getElementById(revealCell.field). If activeCellIn broke and returned null, the fallback would still find the cell, so HealthTool.phone-handoffs tests :142 and :234 would still pass. Predates PR 1517. (H85)
